text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-A-A-Amazing~! Such a magnificent 
building, and the garden is gorgeous!
choice_data_list:
Ah... Nagoya Castle really is a 
breathtaking sight!

Yeah... Nagoya Castle really is a 
breathtaking sight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The third stop on our "Ramen Training 
Journey" was Nagoya City, Aichi 
Prefecture! To get a feel for the local 
area, Meisho Doto and the others visited 
Nagoya Castle.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The shachihoko is so brilliantly golden! 
It's so dazzling, I couldn't take my eyes 
off it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the solemnity, I can also feel 
confidence... Hehe. It's somehow 
reminiscent of Opera O-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh? Opera O-chan?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hai-ee! It's flashy, but not 
obnoxious—that brilliant "sparkle" that 
brings energy to everyone who sees it is 
just like you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...All right! If Opera O-san is watching, 
I'll do my absolute best in Nagoya, too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, that 'miso katsu' was delicious, 
wasn't it? Tonkatsu smothered in sweet 
miso sauce goes insanely well with rice!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, Doto? Since when were you holding 
that, and what is it?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's miso sauce I bought at the store. I 
was wondering if I could make delicious 
ramen with this...
choice_data_list:
Oh, nice! This looks like it'll turn out 
delicious!

W-Wow, nice! Looks like we'll make 
something delicious!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I know this alone isn't enough... 
I know using local specialties isn't all 
it takes to convey my gratitude..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I want to learn more about Nagoya's 
culture and all... That's what I want to 
do, but... ah.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What is it? Curious about that flyer? 
...'Café Neuer, Temp Part-Timers Wanted'?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Local... culture... part-time jobs...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Gasp!! T-T-T-This is it—!!

text_block_list.name: Fine & Top Road
text_block_list.text: Welcome!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Here you go. Two Ankake Spaghettis, order 
up!

text_block_list.name: Nagoya Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Umamusume girls. A 
part-timer suddenly quit and I was in a 
bind, so you really saved me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Not at all~. We've got our own goals to 
take care of too. It's give and take, you 
see~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Working a part-time job to learn the 
local culture firsthand! Yeah, isn't that 
a pretty good idea?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
S-S-Sorry to keep you waiting! Here's your 
ankake spaâHYAAAAAH!!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry! I'll get 
something to wipe it up right—Eeeeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... I'm really just utterly hopeless. 
Someone like me could never possibly repay 
the debt I owe to everyone in Nagoya...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, it's okay. Don't fret over it so 
much—"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So, Nature-san! At the very least... Let's 
at least not cause trouble for the shop!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Won't you train me strictly and 
relentlessly!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...O-Oh, alright. Sure thing. I hear your 
passion loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after receiving a few hours of 
coaching from Nice Nature...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: H-Here, have some iced coffee! ...Ehehe.
choice_data_list:
Oh! You pulled it off splendidly! What did 
you teach her?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I didn't teach them anything special, you 
know? Just told them to see things from 
the customer's perspective.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Stay calm, with a smile. That kind of 
service is what makes a place feel 
comfortable. ...Well, I'm just parroting 
my mother, though.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I did it! Nature-saaan! Were you 
watching...? I... *sniff*. I carried the 
coffee... all by myself!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"She's so happy you'd think she just won a 
GⅠ!? She really makes teaching her 
worthwhile..."

text_block_list.name: Nagoya Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. In that case, could you bring 
some salad to the same table next time?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... yeees! Customer, you ordered a 
salad too, right?

text_block_list.name: Nagoya Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
No. Just the coffee. “From here on” is on 
the house.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? From here on out?"

text_block_list.name: Nagoya Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Then next, a boiled egg and peanuts. And 
Ogura toast, please.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wha... A boiled egg, and peanuts...!? 
E-Even toast, too...!!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaaaa!!!?
choice_data_list:
...Ah, the ogura toasts are floating in 
midair...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...You did well. You did your best, Doto. 
This sheer volume was just too much for 
you too soon...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: M-Manager... S-S-S-S-Sooorry about today!!

text_block_list.name: Nagoya Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine. We were busy too, so we 
couldn't properly teach you the ropes 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... But, I'm so sorrryyy...! Truly, all 
I ever do is cause trouble for youuu...!

text_block_list.name: Nagoya Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
"...Aren't you hungry? I'll make us 
something from the kitchen. Our cafe's 
morning special."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah...! The portion size is incredible! 
I only ordered coffee, but it comes with a 
salad and a boiled egg too...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Top-notch service. Next, I'd like an 
entire Manchu-Han Imperial Feast brought 
out when I order a coffee."
choice_data_list: Though maybe that's aiming a bit too high!

text_block_list.name: Nagoya Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
This is Nagoya-style hospitality. The 
"Morning Service."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"A 'morning service'... Is that what this 
is called?"

text_block_list.name: Nagoya Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. What started out as a service at one 
shop spread throughout Nagoya and became 
part of the culture.

text_block_list.name: Nagoya Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
All I'm doing is just "giving back" to the 
regulars, though. Running a restaurant in 
Nagoya, it's one menu item I really want 
to be particular about.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... I see... âWhat a lovely town 
this is.

text_block_list.name: Nagoya Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
You think so? I don't think it's anything 
particularly special, though.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No, that's wonderful! After all, that 
means the people of Nagoya—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the customers' smiles. 
That's why you did it, right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Such thoughtfulness started from a single 
shop, then spread, took root... and became 
a whole culture. The people of Nagoya 
really are so kind...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. Like how you were so kind to 
me, even when I was messing up and 
completely hopeless!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The manager had every right to be angry 
with me... but instead, seeing how down I 
was, he served me a meal...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Everyone in Nagoya is so dazzling. 
My heart is shining bright like a 
shachihoko...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"To act purely out of a desire to make 
someone smile... I really look up to 
that!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That's—just like that person who, through 
"self-satisfaction," gives energy to 
everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ I just found another great thing 
about Nagoya.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, I see...! That's ittt! That's 
exactly what we should be doing too!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Give back what would make the other 
person happy! Put yourself in the fans' 
shoes and deliver it to them!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I want our ramen to bring smiles to 
people's faces... I'll pour all those 
feelings right into the ramen...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuuuuu~~~! I can picture it so clearly in 
my head, too~~~!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Hey. Don't be a stranger, Doto. Lean on 
your friends at times like this. 
Otherwise, I'll end up feeling lonely."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Alright. The base soup is done. Let's give 
it a taste. *lick* ...Yeah. Innnnnsanely 
bland. Let's add salt.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you so much for helping me out...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But, um... why are you so concerned 
about meee?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Because I've gained a new respect for you.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
At first, I thought you were a cowardly, 
clumsy, gloomy Umamusume whose voice 
always trailed off weakly. I apologize.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Fuehhhh...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Yet I was mistaken. You were a wise 
Umamusume with a wonderful knack for 
finding the good in people and places."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—I thought she was a good girl. That's why 
I wanted to help her.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this, Doto. We'll finish 
this ramen in record time. With the 
leftover time, I'll straighten out the way 
you speak, too.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, indeed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then came the day of the warrior 
training event. At Chukyo Racecourse, they 
were serving ramen “bright and early in 
the morning.” Its name was—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Order up! It's "Morning Ramen"~! Eat this 
up and get all powered up!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Ramen in the morning?!" "Wait, morning 
ramen is a thing?!" "Is it because we're 
in Nagoya?!" "What a wonderful service!" 
"I can't wait!"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hm? But... huh? Appearance-wise, it looks 
like a pretty orthodox ramen, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Ah, shoot! I wanted to check out 
the paddock for the next race, too! Gotta 
hurry over there—

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Wait, my foot got caught—whoaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Aaah!? Senpai!? Senpai fell over! This is 
bad!! The morning ramen she bought me is 
ruined!!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, huh? It didn't... spill?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Morning ramen is the kind of ramen 
that won't spill even if you take a 
tumble.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
*Slurp...* Whoa?! This soup is amazing! 
You couldn't tell just by looking, but 
it's super thick! It clings right to the 
noodles!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh... I based this recipe on Nagoya's 
'Ankake Spaghetti.'

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the thick broth, the noodles and 
toppings won't easily spill out—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Whether you're a child or anyone else! 
It's ramen that lets you move back and 
forth from the racetrack without a worry!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's why... But why make that 
kind of ramen?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...I've always been clumsy, you see. I 
used to drop the ice cream my parents 
bought me right away."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The second ice cream cone she bought for 
me after that... tasted just a little bit 
bitter.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...Because it had the taste of an 
'apology' mixed into it."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want any of you to feel that way. 
That's why I made this ramen!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If the hospitality of the people of Nagoya 
can bring smiles to its visitorsâthen 
I...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I just wanted to make ramen that could 
protect that smile...!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
“Doto-chan...!” “How thoughtful...” “It's 
so delicious!” “Thank you!” “Thanks for 
the treat!” “Seconds, please!”
choice_data_list:
Looks like your feelings really got 
through to them!

Looks like your feelings really got 
through to them!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank goodness... I-I was worried it 
might be presumptuous of someone like me, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Even so, I still wanted to do my best...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"If even a little bit reached you... I'm 
so glad. ...Ehehe♪"
